policy.cancellations: Excluded invoice numbers beginning with C.

policy.missing_customer_id: Retained for invoice-level pattern mining; excluded from customer analytics.
policy.unit_price: Zero prices retained; negative or missing prices excluded from customer monetary analytics.
policy.basket_item: Each distinct StockCode occurs at most once per InvoiceNo.
